_envelope_comment: Derived from the Winston-Salem, NC MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 5 MSA counties (Forsyth, Davidson, Davie, Stokes, Yadkin), Davidson (North Carolina), Davie (North Carolina), Stokes (North Carolina), Yadkin (North Carolina)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 24 geocoded venue(s) of 24 in this batch (observed lat 35.8705..36.2780, lng -80.6350..-80.0936).

_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source='osm' status='draft' row, adjudicated SAME venue by court-verifier on 2026-07-31. UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT. This is also one of the three exact slug collisions in this pass: the OSM row already holds 'davie-family-ymca-mocksville-nc', the exact slug the research row would have inserted. Encoding the reconcile removes the row from the insert set, so the collision resolves as a reconcile target instead of an abort.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row (5 m, identical name, identical 215 Cemetery Street address, and it already holds the exact target slug). The OSM row is access_type='unknown'; the reconcile patches it to the research value 'membership' on the YMCA of Northwest North Carolina's own pickleball page, plus fee_type='fee'. A YMCA is the archetypal 'membership' venue — non-members cannot simply walk on.
